svg.title: Known-best packing of 87 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=87 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: direct retained numerical center/angle facts, read from evand/square-packing@7ff3b2113532889708a3baa4d56bc44294022e63:site/www/data/p/square-87.json, a third party's binary64 parse of the catalogue SVG, and not from the SVG itself. The source metadata supplies attribution and provenance; the upstream SVG is not retained because no express redistribution terms were located. This conservative retention policy is not a legal conclusion. The replayed finite-precision numerical check establishes only tolerance-bounded feasibility of these retained facts, not exact geometry, an exact certificate, or optimality.
